defensiveAbilities.name: Disperse
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The picture-in-clouds takes damage from a hostile action

Effect The picture-in-clouds disperses. Until the end of the current turn, they can't be attacked or targeted, they don't take up space, and any auras or emanations they have are suppressed. At the end of the turn, the picture-in-clouds re-forms in any sufficient space within 150 feet of where they dispersed; any auras or emanations they have are restored as long as the duration didn't run out while the elemental was dispersed.

defensiveAbilities.name: High Winds
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet. Air within the emanation is difficult terrain for Flying creatures that don't have the air trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cloudgaze
offensiveAbilities.description: The picture-in-clouds shifts into their choice of an eagle shape, elephant shape, or sword shape.

offensiveAbilities.name: Elephant Blast
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The picture-in-clouds is in elephant shape

Effect The picture-in-clouds breathes out a 30ft Cone of air from their cloudy trunk. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save to stand their ground. A creature pushed into a solid object stops moving and takes 4d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed 20 feet.

Failure The creature is pushed 40 feet.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 40 feet and knocked Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feather Storm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The picture-in-clouds is in eagle shape

Effect The picture-in-clouds Flies 125 feet, flapping their wings and creating a barrier along their path. This barrier has the effects of Wall of Wind (DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw) and lasts until the end of the picture-in-clouds's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slicing Wind
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The picture-in-clouds is in sword shape

Effect The picture-in-clouds spins, forming a whirlwind that deals 5d8 Slashing Damage damage in a 15ft Emanation (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Push 15 feet
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
